name: [Negative] Technical Issues and Poor Customer Support
description: Users are experiencing frequent technical issues with the platform, causing problems with order executions, account verification, and money withdrawal, which is further compounded by poor customer support.

name: [Negative] Withdrawal and Customer Support Issues
description: Users experienced problems with slow withdrawal of funds, lack of assistance with account-related issues, and difficulties in resolving problems with customer support. Some users reported being on the phone or calling customer support for extended periods without a resolution.
